description: List todo items for a scope. Without agent_id: the user's OWN todos; with agent_id: that agent's todos. user_id defaults to the caller. Optional: done (filter), due_before (ISO), kompakt (true = only id, title, done, priority, due_at, lead_id, created_at, notes cut to 200 chars; default limit 50, max 100 — use it in scheduled/takt runs, a full list of 400 todos is ~115k chars). Open first, then by due/sort_order. Each item carries `url`, the page of that todo in the app — use it when you link a todo, never build one yourself.

done.description: Filter by completion: true = only done, false = only open

due_before.description: Only todos due before this time (ISO)

kompakt.description: Return only key fields with notes cut to 200 chars (default limit 50, max 100)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_todos
